Attached: 1 image

BleachBit 6.0.6, released on 19 October 2026, adds support for Ubuntu 26.10 and new cleaning options for the Helium browser and Docker.

File deletion now runs in 512 KiB chunks, and the release also improves startup speed, deep cleaning and deletion.

It adds cleanup for temporary files from Claude, VS Code and Chromium, improves LibreWolf cleanup, and lets BleachBit on Linux remove more Snap app revisions.
